blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
findings.recommendation: The `q` query-string parameter of `GET /users/search` (src/server.ts:13) is only trimmed and length-checked (2 to 100 characters), then concatenated into the SQL text. An authenticated user with the `support` role who sends `q=x' UNION SELECT id, password_hash FROM users --` reads arbitrary columns of any table (or alters data, depending on the database grants), well within the 100-character limit (CWE-89). Bind the term as a parameter, as `query()` in src/db.ts already supports: `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", [term])`, and escape `%`, `_` and `\` in the term (with `ESCAPE '\'`) so they match literally instead of acting as wildcards. Add a test that sends a quote in `q` and checks it is matched literally.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term
